articles.summary: I boarded the Ardmore Seafox at the Thames port, and in the early hours of the following morning, we set sail. We left at two in the morning, which immediately set the tone for how different life on board is compared to life ashore. It was dark, quiet, and surprisingly calm. Shore lights lined the A first-hand account from Ardmore's Kate Kelly, Marine Performance Analyst on life onboard the Ardmore Seafox, offering insight into seafarer experience, operations and life at sea.
articles.title: ONBOARD THE ARDMORE SEAFOX
